name: Ibuki Cardiology
description: Ibuki Cardiology is a calm, block-based WordPress theme designed for independent outpatient cardiology clinics and healthcare practices. Built with a structured narrative flow, full-bleed documentary imagery, and precise typography, it presents scheduled weekday clinics, timed first visits, and transparent fee tables with clarity and quiet confidence. The theme features custom editorial patterns, responsive block layouts, and accessible styling without relying on external libraries.
